number: 第二百四十八条の四の三
heading_en: Standards for Approval of the SA-CVA
summary_ja: 長官は、エクスポージャー計測モデルが承認前に一年以上運用され、使用開始後に第三款の基準に適合する見込みがあるかを審査する。
summary_en: The Commissioner examines whether the exposure measurement model has been operated in risk management for at least a year before approval and is expected to meet the Subsection 3 standards after use begins.
paragraphs: When the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency intends to grant the approval under Article 248-4, paragraph (1), the Commissioner shall examine whether the exposure measurement model has been operated in the risk management of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company for at least one year before that approval, and whether, on and after the date on which use of the SA-CVA begins, it is expected to conform to the standards for approval provided in Subsection 3.
